source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag ACU Top-Load Dryer Technical Manual (WED5100/WGD5100)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Mode entered. Use Service Diagnostics (HMI Test, Sensor Feedback, Diagnostic Cycle) as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Service Diagnostics → Diagnostic Cycle
steps.body: Advance to Sensing phase with Right key. Open door and touch both moisture strips with wet cloth — drum light should turn off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Advance to Sensing phase with Right key. Open door and touch both moisture strips with wet cloth — drum light should turn off.

steps.title: Door open short check
steps.body: Open dryer door. Immediate beep or display response indicates short in moisture sensor harness — inspect harness and sensor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open dryer door. Immediate beep or display response indicates short in moisture sensor harness — inspect harness and sensor.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Repair short in moisture sensor harness or replace sensor.

steps.title: Wet cloth bridge test
steps.body: Touch both strips with wet cloth — status should change open→closed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Touch both strips with wet cloth — status should change open→closed.

branches.label: Fails
branches.oemOutcome: Sensor failed wet-cloth test — bench test J13 harness at ACU.

steps.title: Bench J13 harness
steps.body: Disconnect J13 at ACU. Check harness to sensor; outer contacts to ground must be OL.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect J13 at ACU. Check harness to sensor; outer contacts to ground must be OL.

steps.title: Repair moisture short
steps.oemOutcome: Clear short or replace moisture sensor / wire harness.

steps.title: Moisture sensor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Sensor responds in service mode and harness OK.
